headline: Singapore Banks May Restrict Financing for Companies Linked to Deforestation
summary: Singapore authorities warned that listed firms linked to illegal burning face financial penalties, while domestic banks may curb lending under a zero-tolerance approach to regional haze.
why: Singapore is a primary financing hub for Southeast Asian commodities, and stricter green lending standards can limit capital access for agribusiness operators.

impacts.name: Southeast Asian Agribusiness
impacts.why: Restrictions on bank credit and potential legal penalties raise funding costs for companies tied to haze.
